title: Generation of expandable cardiovascular progenitor cells from mouse and human fibroblasts via direct chemical reprogramming
protocol: Prepare mouse and human fibroblast cells.
Remove head, spinal cords, and all developing organs from mouse embryos for MEF preparation.
Maintain MEFs in fibroblast medium and use cells that have been passaged less than three times.
Use human foreskin fibroblast (HFF) line CRL2097 for reprogramming.
Culture HFF on gelatin-coated dishes in fibroblast medium.
Coat a 12-well plate with matrigel for mouse ciCPC induction and place the plate in a 37°C, 5% CO2 tissue culture incubator for at least 1 hour.
Coat a 6-well plate with vitronectin for human ciCPC induction and place the plate in a 37°C, 5% CO2 tissue culture incubator for at least 1 hour.
Remove coating reagent.
Plate 10,000 MEFs, 20,000 TTFs, or 40,000 HFFs per well in pre-warmed fibroblast medium.
Place the plate in a 37°C, 5% CO2 tissue culture incubator for at least 8 hours.
Gently rock the plate to evenly distribute fibroblasts.
Aspirate fibroblast medium without touching the bottom of the plate.
Wash with PBS twice.
Add 2 mL of fresh mouse ciCPC reprogramming medium or 2.5 mL of human ciCPC reprogramming medium per well along the side wall, avoiding direct contact with cells.
Place the plate in a 37°C, 5% CO2 tissue culture incubator.
Replace with fresh reprogramming medium every 2 days.
Aspirate reprogramming medium from plates after 8 days for mouse induction or 20 days for human induction.
Wash with PBS twice.
Add 2 mL of fresh mouse or human ciCPC induction medium per well.
Return the plates to the incubator.
Change the medium every 2 days.
After 6 days, pick mouse or human ciCPC colonies for further expansion.
Pick mouse or human ciCPC colonies into a 1.5 mL-tube.
Centrifuge picked colonies at 800 g for 3 min at 25°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 0.1 mL collagenase B, and digest for 10 min at 37°C.
Quench the enzyme by adding 0.1 mL of fresh ciCPC expansion medium.
Centrifuge digested cells at 800 g for 3 min at 25°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant and resuspend the picked colonies in 0.1 mL of accutase.
Digest for 5 min at 37°C.
Repeat the procedure.
Remove the supernatant carefully after digestion with accutase.
Resuspend digested cells in 0.1 mL of fresh ciCPC expansion medium.
Seed cells into a well of a vitronectin-coated 96-well plate.
Do not rock the plate to prevent cells from gathering in the center upon shaking.
Culture ciCPCs until they reach confluence for passaging.
Aspirate the ciCPC expansion medium when ready to passage.
Wash the cells twice with PBS.
Add 0.1 mL collagenase B per well of 96-well plate and digest for 10 min at 37°C.
Carefully remove collagenase B without dislodging the cells.
Add 0.1 mL accutase per well of 96-well plate for 5 min at 37°C.
Quench the enzyme by adding 0.1 mL of fresh ciCPC expansion medium into each well.
Collect all undetached cells from the well and transfer them to a 15-mL tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 800 g for 3 minutes at 25°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL of fresh expansion medium.
Pipette the cells up and down thoroughly.
Add the single-cell suspensions to a vitronectin-coated 24-well plate.
Gently rock the plate to evenly distribute the ciCPCs.
Place the plate in a 37°C, 5% CO2 tissue culture incubator.
Routinely passage the cells every 3–4 days for mouse ciCPCs or every 4–6 days for human ciCPCs at a density of 5×10^5 cells per well of a 12-well plate.
Change the culture medium every 2 days.
Maintain stable growth rate and undifferentiated morphology in defined culture conditions.
Mix accutase-dissociated mouse ciCPCs with fresh CM differentiation medium.
Plate the mixture onto a vitronectin-coated plate at a density of 3×10^5 cells per cm².
Change the medium every 2 days for continuous 7 days.
Monitor for synchronized contraction usually by day 7.
Suspend accutase-dissociated mouse ciCPCs with fresh SMC differentiation medium.
Add the suspension to a vitronectin-coated plate at a density of 1×10^4 cells per cm².
Culture for continuous 7 days, changing the medium every 2 days.
Monitor differentiated SMCs at day 7.
Plate accutase-dissociated mouse ciCPCs onto a vitronectin-coated plate in EGM-2 medium.
Maintain culture conditions for continuous 7 days at a density of 1×10^4 cells per cm².
Change the medium every 2 days.
Monitor differentiated ECs at day 7.
Reconstitute hESC line H1 on vitronectin-coated plates in TeSR-E8 medium.
Culture hESCs until they reach 80%–90% confluence.
Switch to hESC CM differentiation medium and designate this day as day 0.
Change the medium daily from days 0 to 7.
Change the medium every 2-3 days after day 7.
Add correct supplements at indicated dosages and times.
Reseed cells onto gelatin-coated plates in human CM culture medium on day 20.
Collect conditioned medium of differentiated CMs starting from day 30.
Harvest the medium every 2 days until day 60.
Split the conditioned medium into 15-mL tubes.
Store the conditioned medium at -80°C for future use.
Plate accutase-dissociated human ciCPCs onto the vitronectin-coated plate in fresh human ciCPC CM differentiation medium for 14 days at a density of 3×10^5 cells per cm².
Renew culture medium every 2 days during differentiation.
Use freshly thawed conditioned medium for cardiac differentiation of human ciCPCs.
